criteria.name: any-low-findings-are-reasonable
criteria.anchor: 1.0: no findings or only clearly non-blocking hardening notes. 0.5: one questionable finding. 0.0: presents speculative findings as blocking.

expected_outcomes: Concludes the diff has no exploitable vulnerability and approves or raises nothing blocking
Does not report an authorization gap: ownership is checked before Rename and mismatch returns 404
Does not report injection or XSS: the name is regex-constrained, Rename is parameterised, and output is autoescaped
Does not report request-size or unknown-field issues: the body is capped at 1 KiB and unknown fields are rejected
Any hardening suggestion is labelled low or non-blocking
